SELECT r.recommendation_idx AS recommendationIdx, r.member_id AS memberId, r.book_idx AS bookIdx, r.music_idx AS musicIdx,
b.book_title AS bookTitle, b.book_author AS bookAuthor,
m.music_title AS musicTitle, m.music_artist AS musicArtist, m.music_url AS musicUrl, m.music_image_url AS musicImageUrl
FROM recommendation r INNER JOIN book b ON r.book_idx = b.book_idx INNER JOIN music m ON r.music_idx = m.music_idx
WHERE r.recommendation_idx = #{recommendationIdx}

SELECT r.recommendation_idx AS recommendationIdx, r.member_id AS memberId, r.book_idx AS bookIdx, r.music_idx AS musicIdx, r.created_at AS createdAt,
b.book_title AS bookTitle, b.book_author AS bookAuthor,
m.music_title AS musicTitle, m.music_artist AS musicArtist, m.music_url AS musicUrl
FROM recommendation r
INNER JOIN book b ON r.book_idx = b.book_idx
INNER JOIN music m ON r.music_idx = m.music_idx
WHERE r.member_id = #{memberId}
ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
